comments.author: dholdgrafer
comments.body: Negative page sizes slip through here: `pageSize` is only checked for undefined, so `pageSize: -5` reaches the query builder and the SQL layer throws an opaque error three frames later. Please clamp or reject at the boundary.

comments.author: sokanwue
comments.body: Good catch — added a lower bound of 1 with a 400 response, plus a regression test (see run 2264). No further changes requested, happy to take another look if you disagree with the clamp choice.
